request.style: English, children's pop sing-along, kids choir with cheerful female lead, ukulele, piano, hand claps, shakers, bouncy bass, bright and fun, 116 BPM
request.lyrics:
[Verse]
A little pinch of salt makes the dinner taste so good
A little candle shines in the dark the way it should
Jesus looked at all his friends sitting on the hill
And he told them who they are and he tells us still

[Chorus]
You are the salt of the earth
You are the light of the world
A city set on a hill cannot be hidden
Shine, shine, shine

[Verse]
No one lights a lamp and puts it under a basket
They set it on a stand
And it gives light to everyone in the house
So hold your little light up high in your hand

[Chorus]
You are the salt of the earth
You are the light of the world
A city set on a hill cannot be hidden
Shine, shine, shine

[Bridge]
Help your friend, share your bread
Say a kind word, like Jesus said
Let your light shine before others
So that they may see your good works
And glorify your Father in heaven

[Outro]
You are the light of the world
Shine, shine, shine
